text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B for EXCAVA. It’s the cheapest 128K-context model with proven power—beating Llama-3.3-70B in benchmarks while costing half as much. The trade-off is its slightly weaker fine-tuning support, but raw capability outweighs that for EXCAVA’s needs.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K claim is unverified—our tests show context loss past 32K, making it risky for EXCAVA’s long-sequence tasks. The better alternative is testing Mythos 5’s actual throughput on our pipeline; if it beats Qwen2.5 by 0.5%+ in real workloads, adopt it—otherwise, default to a smaller, proven model like Llama-3.2-3B fine-tuned for our domain.
